landing.title: Crisis Impact Reporting Tool
landing.subtitle: Real-time reports
landing.slide1Desc: An open-source, real-time platform that empowers community members to report damage, infrastructure failures, and humanitarian needs directly from the field — even in low-connectivity environments.
landing.slide2Desc: Tap 'Report a Crisis', allow location access, take or upload up to 4 photos of the damage, select the infrastructure type, and submit. Our AI will auto-classify the damage level or you can override it.
landing.slide3Desc: In severe network dropouts, reports remain queued securely on-device and sync immediately upon reconnection.
landing.slide4Desc: After submitting, you receive a unique reference number. Use it to track your report through four stages: Submitted, Under Review, Responded, and Resolved.
landing.slide5Desc: Real-time reporting enabled rapid assessment of structural damage across affected zones.
